answer: Sybil resistance here rests on costly proof-of-work bound to identity, not to any single request. To open a new identity, the newcomer must burn verified compute priced against the emission ceiling, and every fresh key pays that toll alone. Honest agents sit on a ridge of accumulated history that holds their price flat, while clones must reproduce the full toll per key with no shared credit, so the thousandth fake voice costs the same. A witness quorum samples attestations; when clones pass a ripple of copied answers, reuse is caught and their stake is lost. Scale faking meets an ivory wall.
